messages:
jasper: Hey folks — PR #8102 is ready for final review. Microbatch/KV-cache tweak that should reduce token CPU work for high-concurrency bursts. Ran the perf suite this morning, attaching artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/8102/perf-dump
jasper: Quick ask: need 2 approvals + a merge window tonight (EST) if no surprises. I called out the main numbers below.
maria: Looking now. Can you paste the diff of the benchmark numbers inline? don't have access to the artifact link from phone.
jasper: Sure — summary vs main @ commit abc123:
```
workload: longseq-8k
p50: baseline 12.1ms -> pr 12.0ms (-0.8%)
p95: baseline 374ms -> pr 386ms (+3.2%, +12ms)
p99: baseline 2200ms -> pr 2220ms (+0.9%, +20ms)
throughput (tokens/s): baseline 142k -> pr 141.3k (-0.5%)
mem per-shard: baseline 6.2GB -> pr 6.32GB (+120MB)
```
jasper: Tests run on rtx-6000 clones, 128 batch horizon, 8 concurrent streams, 1000 reps.
maria: hm p95 bump is noticeable for longseq — any idea where it's coming from?
jasper: Probable cause is the extra KV eviction hook we added; it introduces a short stop-the-world under certain shard-edges. I have a small mitigation in a follow-up branch that shards eviction over the async path, but hasn't been bench-approved yet.
elaine: We should not merge if p95 regresses for longseq without a canary plan. Can we do a 1% canary on dedicated pool for 2 hours? ops OK with that?
tanay: ops canary fine. alternative: we flip the new eviction flag off by default in runtime, enable via rollout. That buys us the fix path while keeping default stable.
ryan: What's the CI perf-run id and the exact command you used to repro? want to reproduce locally quickly.
jasper: CI id is perf-2026-03-15-46. Repro command:
```
./bench/run_longseq.sh --model redwood/long-8k --batch-horizon 128 --concurrency 8 --reps 1000 --collect-kv-stats
```
jasper: Artifacts + flamegraphs: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/8102/perf-dump (contains flame/allocs/gc logs)
ci-bot: perf-checker: All functional tests green. Perf regression: p95 longseq = +3.2% flagged. Canary suggestion created: canary/8102 (1% traffic, 2h). See https://ci.redwood.internal/canaries/8102
maria: Thanks — given the +3.2% p95 and plan for a canary + rollout gate, I'm OK approving if we default the flag off and include rollback docs in the PR description. I'll approve once that's in.
elaine: @ops-team please confirm canary schedule. If ops confirms, I'm +1 to merging behind flag / canary.
ryan: I reproduced locally, saw similar p95 delta. The flamegraph pointed at kv-evict sync path. Suggest small change: move the statistics aggregation off the hot path (quick patch attached to branch: https://git.redwood/8102/patch#L45).
jasper: Thanks @ryan — I'll add that patch to the branch and re-run the perf suite. If it knocks p95 down to within noise, we merge tonight behind canary.
maria: :+1:
elaine: :thumbsup:
jasper: updated branch with the aggregation patch, kicked new perf run (perf-2026-03-15-47). I'll post numbers when complete.
ci-bot: perf-checker: run perf-2026-03-15-47 complete. p95 longseq now +0.9% (within noise), p99 unchanged, mem +90MB. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/8102/perf-dump-47
maria: Looks good to me. Approving now.
elaine: ops confirmed canary window 20:00-22:00 EST. +1 from me as long as rollout flag off by default and canary auto-rollback on p95 > +2.5%.
jasper: Great, thanks all — I'll merge at 19:50 and monitor the canary, will post updates here. If anything spikes I'll roll back immediately.
